data.name: book of element
data.detailed_description:
Become an Elementalist, a being capable of casting powerful spells from their grimoire.

In this competitive deck-building game, face other Elementalists in intense duels to prove that you are worthy of
becoming the greatest master of your element.

Book of Element is a card game that is easy to learn, fast-paced, yet deeply strategic, where every match feels unique thanks to its deckbuilding system and mana management.

⚔️ Fight using the power of the elements!

Choose between multiple elements and shape your own magical playstyle by mixing — or not — different spell archetypes.

Wind allows you to quickly refill your hand before unleashing surprising combos 🌪️

Fire burns you in exchange for power, though patience may reward you 🔥

Water heals your wounds before unleashing powerful waves against your opponent 🌊

Earth protects you from enemy spells before crushing your target with devastating magic ⛰️

✨ The Absolute Spell, the finishing touch

Complete your grimoire with an Absolute Spell, a joker card that can only be played once during a duel. Capable of turning an entire match around, you will need to master it… and survive your opponent’s Absolute Spell.

🎮 Accessible to everyone

Whether you enjoy:
aggressive gameplay, control, combos, strategy, or simply having fun,
there is a place for every Elementalist.

🏆 Multiple game modes

Story Mode
Discover the world of the game, learn the elemental mechanics, and train against the Elementalists of this universe.

Multiplayer Mode
Challenge players from around the world. Ranked or casual, become the greatest Elementalist and carve your name into history.

Tournament Mode
Push your limits with unique restrictions, new rules, and the tension of elimination matches. Become the champion of the elemental tournaments.

⭐ Tested and enjoyed by both children and adults, Book of Element offers an excellent balance between accessibility and strategic depth, perfect for players of all ages looking for a competitive and creative card game.
